note: The fixture pair for retries at several layers (RTY-02, in retry-policy) and retry budgets (RTY-05, the retry-budget check), rank 6's parts in fixtures/PLAN.md, layers form: axios-retry 4.5.0, p-retry 9.0.0 and got 16.2.0 under Express, scanned with retry-policy and retry-budget. Written by hand: each planted defect is fixed in place in the clean twin, line for line, and the twins differ in nothing else. The clean twin keeps one layer per call, turning the inner retry off for that call (axios-retry's per-request 'axios-retry': { retries: 0 }, got's retry: { limit: 0 }) or dropping the outer one, and every remaining retry draws on the budget in src/budget.js, imported on the line after the imports. The planted twin has the same src/budget.js and uses it only on the decoys. got retries GET, PUT, HEAD, DELETE, OPTIONS, TRACE and QUERY twice by default and never POST (got 16.2.0, source/core/options.ts). A finding catches a defect when its check matches and its locations name the defect's file, line, column and symbol (every place, when the defect lists several), with the defect's severity. Decoys are in both twins; reporting one is a false positive. Paths are relative to each twin. Nothing here is installed or run.
